# Issuer (`issuer` v1)

Issuer of bonds and reference entity for CDS.

**Group:** Counterparty and legal · **Mnemonic:** `ISS` · **Identifiers:** `ISS-…` in `issuerId`

Open one with `ISS <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: issuer
version: 1
description: Issuer of bonds and reference entity for CDS.
match: { kind: issuer, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Counterparty and legal · Issuer, id: $.issuerId }
strip:
  - { label: Name, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Rating, bind: $.rating, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Sector, bind: $.sector }
  - { label: Country, bind: $.country }
panels:
  - id: bonds
    kind: table
    title: Bonds outstanding
    key: F2
    rows: $.bonds
    columns:
      - { label: ISIN, bind: "@.isin" }
      - { label: Coupon, bind: "@.coupon", fmt: pct2 }
      - { label: Maturity, bind: "@.maturity", fmt: date }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.creditCurve, 'credit-curve')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
